finding: `audit:trust-passport-trustslip-boundary` failed because the holder browser smoke expects the QR and public Decision Pack link to carry the same selected Decision Pack URL.
impact: Base public TrustSlip verify boundary passes, but purpose-specific Decision Pack QR/link parity needs repair before claiming every TrustSlip Decision Pack path is fully verified.
recovery: Fix or update the smoke and product code so selected Decision Pack URL, QR value, and public link agree; rerun Trust Passport/TrustSlip boundary audit.

finding: `npm --prefix frontend run audit:whatsapp-bridge-contract` is missing, although `node tools/audit-whatsapp-bridge-contract.mjs` passes from the frontend directory.
impact: Contract is protected but not exposed through the standard npm audit script list.
recovery: Add package.json script alias or document node-direct invocation in internal QA runbook.

finding: This pass captured representative current route screenshots, not every modal, setup success state, edit control, failed recovery state, and advanced detail panel.
impact: Guide screenshots are valid examples but not complete proof for every feature state.
recovery: Run deeper Playwright walkthrough with seeded success/edit/error states before publishing screenshot-heavy training.

finding: `test_marketplace_public_shop.py` produced sandbox temp-directory errors locally but passed when rerun outside sandbox: 59 passed.
impact: No product failure confirmed; local sandbox temp permissions can mislead future test runs.
recovery: Use approved external pytest run or repair inaccessible `.pytest_*`/Temp permissions.

finding: `view_image` could not inspect the screenshot contact sheet because the Windows sandbox wrapper refused split writable roots.
impact: Automated screenshot existence/text checks passed, but visual QA via image viewer was not completed inside this session.
recovery: Open screenshots manually or use approved visual QA run where image viewer can access the workspace.

finding: The repository already contains unrelated modified/untracked docs and deliverables outside this guide package.
impact: Staging/pushing must be selective; do not assume all dirty files belong to this audit.
recovery: Stage only the guide package and raw inventory if owner asks to push this batch.

finding: The formal DOCX-to-PNG render workflow could not run locally because `pdf2image` is not installed and `soffice`/LibreOffice is not available on PATH.
impact: Markdown, DOCX, and PDF files were generated and structurally validated, but page-image visual QA for the Word layout was not completed in this environment.
recovery: Install the document render dependencies or run the render workflow on a machine with `pdf2image`, Poppler, and LibreOffice available; then inspect rendered pages.
